title: Lugging Recommendation
intro: Recommended procedure for terminating flexible conductors with standard lugs.

items.body: Cut at required length and remove.
Cut section and slide towards the end of the conductor (allow 5mm clearance).

image.alt: Step 2 — slide cut section toward conductor end

items.body: Place standard lug at the end of conductor.
Gently push both lug and section until they meet the jacket. Cut and remove section.

image.alt: Step 4 — seat lug and remove section

items.body: Compress lug using hexagonal die and hydraulic crimper.

blocks.body: Stripping at 25mm maximum lengths is recommended. For longer lengths cutting and stripping in 25mm sections is advised.
